context.body: The confession of divine greatness stands beside administrative labor counts.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Solomon requests a skilled worker and timber from Huram, acknowledges that heaven cannot contain God, and numbers resident foreigners for labor.
observations.label: Solomon prepares a great house: action

observations.body: Foreign laborers, carriers, cutters, and supervisors are assigned to the project.
observations.label: Solomon prepares a great house: response

observations.body: great house · heaven cannot contain him · resident foreigners · burden bearers
observations.label: Words in 2 Chronicles 2:1–18

payload.posture: Read 2 Chronicles 2:1–18 as building the house evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The house is called great while its builder denies that it can contain God.
payload.title: Solomon prepares a great house
